metadata.description: Accommodation data plugins by StayingAPI — hotels and vacation rentals across four booking platforms in one schema.

plugins.name: stayingapi
plugins.description: Hotel and vacation-rental data for AI agents — search, availability, pricing, cross-OTA price comparison and reviews across Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and Google Hotels in one unified schema, via the hosted StayingAPI MCP server. Read-only, OAuth sign-in, free tier.
